title: Project Manager - PMO
description:
Title: Project Manager - PMO
Location: West Trenton, NJ
Type: Contract
 
Our direct client is seeking a Project Manager to serve as a strong advocate and partner dedicated to driving the facilitation, planning, and successful execution of approved business initiatives. The Project Manager is responsible for managing one or more projects from startup through closeout and ensuring customer satisfaction. This individual needs to be very comfortable around technology, be inquisitive, have a problem-solving mindset, and be willing to adapt their approach to successfully execute projects.

Key Accountabilities:
  • Manage one or more independent projects from startup to closeout with some input from senior PMO members.
  • Demonstrate accountability with guidance from senior project managers or portfolio managers towards project implementations and ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Demonstrate understanding and proficiency of Agile project management techniques and processes.  
  • Hold self and project team members accountable to deliverables and commitments.
  • Demonstrate awareness of project metrics and using metrics towards project discussions.
  • Work with Portfolio leadership to deal with dynamic situations and ambiguity.
  • Demonstrate the ability to adapt and perform in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.
  • Collaborate with Technical Leads for release and sprint planning, brainstorming, etc.
  • Demonstrate an analytical mindset and be comfortable working with data.
  • Take charge of situations, challenges, and leading the team toward a resolution with guidance from senior project managers or portfolio managers.
  • Provide direction and day-to-day management of project teams.
  • Communicate transparently through status reporting and managing expectations of senior PMO leaders.
  • Understand project objectives and ensure team member commitment toward achieving those objectives.
  • Engage in discussions with team members to propose alternative solutions / approaches to address challenges.
  • Identify challenges and risks (not just reporting status) and proactively seek resolution through support from PMO leadership.
  • Demonstrate awareness of various risk management strategies.
  • Prepare presentations regarding projects and their statuses to small audiences.
 
Required Skills:
  • Minimum 4-year degree or equivalent experience; technical or business background preferred.
  • Minimum 5-year work experience in a team setting; willingness to continue working in a team setting.
  • Basic understanding of tooling such as Jira, Planview, etc. Very proficient in MS Office (Excel, MS Word) and able to learn and utilize tooling.
  • Excellent and effective verbal communication, written communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  • Scaled Agile or Scrum Master experience / certifications preferred.
  • Experience with project budget management is preferred.
  • Experience and understanding of P&C insurance a big plus.
 
 
Partner's Consulting is an award-winning IT Consulting and Recruiting firm based in the Philadelphia area. We’ve built personal relationships with our clients over many years and work directly with decision makers on all open positions. Our core values are focused on the highest level of professional dedication to our client's requirements coupled with our desire to partner with highly qualified talent for joint success.
